Note: This is not a compilation album, both issues were joined by the original publisher due to a missed deadline on their part as well as a lack of submissions. The circle was exceedingly small and had an even lower readership.

A fanzine covering special effects films and TV series like Godzilla and Ultraman. This partiuclar imprint is very amateur, however, a lot of love clearly went into it - lots of the information is very revealing and provides as 1st person source on those who were in the thick of it. Acquired for the sake of posterity - each cover is hand colored by the staff, showing just how homebrew this publication was. It's one of my prized possessions, so I wanted to share.
